description:
SOLD IN 24 HOURS

Located in the ever sought after village of Brompton within the county of North Yorkshire and situated just off the main village green with access through a small ginnel, this beautifully presented two bedroom cottage is perfect for semi rural living. The village's location offers a wide history of the linen mills and the Willow Beck river that runs through the village. The village has a vibrant community sharing news, events, and information. The cottage is also steeped in history as it used to be a Manor House in the 1900s. During the 70s, the Manor House was converted into a hotel where this cottage was the restaurant. The cottage briefly comprises of open plan lounge / dining room, kitchen, two bedrooms and family bathroom. Externally there is a paved seating area to the frontage, communal garden areas alongside the Willow Beck river, garage and off road parking. The present owners have sympathetically updated the cottage whilst retaining character features. Simply charming!

ENTRANCE Via a feature upvc framed double glazed door leading into the lounge area.

LOUNGE/DINER A charming lounge and open plan dining area, full of character including feature timber beams, exposed stone archway feature, space for a dining table and chairs, upvc framed double glazed window, stairs access to the first floor.

KITCHEN With a range of modern fitted cream hi gloss base and wall units with chrome fittings, laminate work surfaces, inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, cream gloss brick style tiling to splash and work surfaces, integrated electric oven and hob, dishwasher, fridge freezer and plumbing for the automatic washing machine, feature beams to the ceiling, upvc framed double glazed window.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING With feature beams to the ceiling, upvc framed double glazed window, wall mounted electric heater, built in storage cupboard with inset shelving housing the hot water tank. Loft access and the loft is fully boarded.

BEDROOM ONE With panelled feature wall, beams to the ceiling, wall mounted electric heater, upvc framed double glazed window,

BEDROOM TWO With beams to the ceiling, wall mounted electric heater, upvc framed double glazed window.

BATHROOM With a fitted white suite comprising of; panel bath with shower attachment and an inset mains rainhead shower, wash hand basin, wc, white gloss brick effect tiling to splash and vanity areas, beams to the ceiling, upvc framed double glazed window.

EXTERNALLY

To the frontage there is a paved garden area which provides for most pleasant outdoor seating with space for a bistro table and chairs, whilst to the end of the row of terraces there is a communal, wall enclosed, paved area where there is access to the greenhouse and space to air washing, this is all funded by the Manor Court community. Behind the communal area is the Garage that belongs to the property which has had a recently re felted roof. There is a parking space in front of the garage which provides for ample car parking. There is also an additional seating area, a most peaceful and tranquil spot, which again is upkept by the Manor Court community and has a seated bench , surrounded by mature trees, shrubbery and flora with the local Willow Beck river running alongside.
